# SpeakUp

> A web app for practising spoken English. Learners talk out loud with an AI
> conversation partner, or get matched with another learner at a similar
> level. It runs in the browser and can be installed to a phone home screen.

SpeakUp exists because most English learners can read and write far better
than they can speak. Speaking is the part that needs a partner, and a partner
is the part most learners do not have. The AI partner removes the scheduling
problem; the human matching gives them the real thing when they want it.

## How it works

- A learner picks a CEFR level from A1 (beginner) to C2 (advanced) when they
  sign up, and can change it later.
- They choose a topic, or free talk, then speak into their microphone.
- Speech is turned into text in the browser. The AI replies in text and the
  reply is spoken back.
- The AI matches its vocabulary and sentence length to the learner's level.
  At A1 it answers in one or two short sentences; at C1 and C2 it speaks
  naturally and pushes back.
- Every reply ends with one question, so the learner always has something to
  respond to.
- Conversations are English only. If the learner slips into another language,
  the app nudges them back, gently at lower levels and firmly at higher ones.

## Facts worth getting right

- Free to start. Practice minutes are capped per day.
- No audio is recorded or stored. Only the transcribed text is saved.
- Transcripts are private to the learner. A conversation partner never sees
  them.
- Talking with a real person is limited to adults. Accounts under 13 are not
  allowed at all.
- It works in any modern browser with microphone support. Chrome on desktop
  and Android and Safari on iOS 16.4 or newer are the best supported.
- Installing to the home screen is optional. Nothing is downloaded from an
  app store.

## Pages

- /: what the product is, and sign-up
- /signup, /login: accounts
- /guidelines: how people are expected to behave with each other
- /privacy: what speech data is processed and stored
